title: GraphAHA: Graph-Based Adaptive Search with Heterogeneous Actions for Test-Time Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.12757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time scaling improves code generation by spending additional inference budget (e.g., calls or tokens) on direct sampling, feedback-conditioned repair, and reasoning-guided implementation. Search-based methods can allocate this budget adaptively, but two challenges remain. First, tree-structured search treats each generation history as a separate state even when trajectories converge to the same program, duplicating evaluation and preventing statistics from being shared. Second, sampling, repair, and reasoning have complementary and state-dependent payoffs, making online allocation among them difficult under a finite budget. To address these challenges, we propose an adaptive graph search method with heterogeneous actions (GraphAHA). GraphAHA organizes the test-time code generation in a typed directed acyclic graph. translated_title: GraphAHA：基于图的异构动作自适应搜索，用于测试时代码生成
translated_abstract: 测试时扩展通过在直接采样、反馈条件修复和推理引导实现上花费额外的推理预算（如调用次数或令牌数）来改进代码生成。基于搜索的方法可以自适应地分配这一预算，但仍存在两个挑战。第一，树状结构搜索将每条生成历史视为独立的状态，即使轨迹收敛到同一个程序，也会导致重复评估并阻止统计信息的共享。第二，采样、修复和推理具有互补且依赖于状态的收益，使得在有限预算下进行在线分配十分困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种具有异构动作的自适应图搜索方法。GraphAHA 将测试时代码生成组织在一个带类型的有向无环图中，等价的程序被合并为单一的代码节点，使其下游搜索统计信息可以在不同分支间重用。
tldr: 提出GraphAHA方法，通过将测试时代码生成组织为带类型的有向无环图，合并等价程序以共享搜索统计信息，并自适应分配采样、修复和推理等异构动作，从而在有限推理预算下提升代码生成效果。
en_tdlr: GraphAHA organizes test-time code generation in a typed directed acyclic graph that merges equivalent programs to share search statistics and adaptively allocates heterogeneous actions—sampling, repair, and reasoning—under a finite inference budget.
